title: Jonas Johansson
description: Jonas Johansson is an artist, educator, and designer from Glommen, Halland, working with light and technology through play, community, and (un)human intervention.
intro: Jonas Johansson is a designer, artist and educator from Glommen, Halland. He studied graphic design in Norrköping, Reims, and Stockholm, and has worked at design studios in [Tokyo](https://ultrasupernew.com/), [Montreal](https://momentfactory.com/), [London](https://field.io/) and Munich. He taught Visual Communication at [Beckmans](https://beckmans.se/) (2017–2025) and Creative Technology at [Hyper Island](https://www.hyperisland.com/) (2014–2022). Jonas runs the artist residency [Visualia](https://visualia.se/) and [Nordic Audiovisual Artists](https://nava.community), plans courses at [Svenska Tecknare](https://svenskatecknare.se/), creates events with [PLX](https://plxplxplx.com/) and [Lumen Project](https://lumenproject.se), collaborates with the lighting collective [Svartljus](https://svartljus.se/), and co-founded [Dome Dreaming](https://www.domedreaming.com), the Nordics' first fulldome film festival. He shares his studio with [SMASH](https://www.smash.studio/) and [Rose Hallgren](https://rosehallgren.se/).
